title: Numeric representation
description: Choose the standard-library representation for jq numbers while preserving the corpus-required distinction between literal preservation and arithmetic conversion.
system_choice: Use Python float for arithmetic and comparisons, retain original numeric spellings where required for serialization, and expose have_decnum as false so the corpus selects its supported non-decnum behavior.

title: Regex implementation
description: Choose the standard-library regex strategy for jq regular-expression builtins because the target cannot install Oniguruma or another third-party binding.
system_choice: Use Python re with a compatibility translation layer for jq-supported flags and named captures.
